Original BERT4Rec generates D random-mask copies plus one last-only copy of each training window: explicit terminal-example probability 1/(D+1), about 9.1% at default D=10. Random masking selects m=min(cap,max(1,round(ρn))) positions uniformly without replacement, including the last position with probability m/n; it is not restricted to interiors. Last-only examples retain every preceding item; reconstruction examples permit visible context on both sides. Training uses deterministic sliding windows, not uniformly sampled prefix endpoints. Despite an 80% comment, default mask_prob=1 replaces every selected target with MASK. [Original generator](https://github.com/FeiSun/BERT4Rec/blob/master/gen_data_fin.py).

Petrov–Macdonald’s released BERT4Rec configuration uses random ItemsMasking for training and force_last=True for validation; it adds no explicit terminal-training branch. Default masking density is 20%, capped at 20 targets, all replaced with MASK. Important implementation detail: mask count uses the incoming history length before suffix truncation; therefore retained-window density can exceed 20%. Training takes each history’s latest window, without random-prefix sampling. Their RSS objective is a separate sampling method, not a synonym for terminal/interior masking. [Configuration](https://github.com/asash/bert4rec_repro/blob/main/evaluation/configs/bert4rec_repro_paper/common_benchmark_config.py), [masking implementation](https://github.com/asash/bert4rec_repro/blob/main/recommenders/dnn_sequential_recommender/targetsplitters/items_masking.py).

A 50/50 terminal/reconstruction mixture is consequently distinct from both released defaults, provided branch inputs differ as described. Specify prefix-endpoint distribution, whether reconstruction includes the terminal position, mask count/replacement, visible context and reduction. Original loss averages across all selected targets in the batch; Petrov’s Hugging Face model likewise uses masked-label loss. Thus equal example counts do not imply equal objective weights: with m reconstruction targets, terminal tokens contribute approximately 1/(1+m). Separately averaging each branch and combining 0.5L_terminal+0.5L_reconstruction explicitly balances objectives. [Original loss](https://github.com/FeiSun/BERT4Rec/blob/master/run.py), [Petrov model](https://github.com/asash/bert4rec_repro/blob/main/recommenders/dnn_sequential_recommender/models/bert4rec/bert4rec.py).
